text.p: Digicall Ltd said on Friday it had requested the suspension of its shares on the Australian Stock Exchange pending the finalisation of discussions with Vodaphone Group.
Digicall, a mobile telecommuniciations reseller, said on Thursday that U.K.-based Vodafone had security over all of Digicall's assets.
Late last month Digicall said it was in funding talks with Vodafone after a write-off of expenses linked to uneconomic accounts. Digicall's shares slumped after that announcement.

Digicall's shares last traded one cent lower at 12 cents on Friday morning, just before a trading halt was applied at the request of the company. The company has a market capitalisation of A$9.26 million based on its last traded price and with 77.21 million shares outstanding. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373-1800
